title: Near-Optimal List Replicability from Littlestone Dimension
abstract: arXiv:2610.32853v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the list replicability number in the realizable PAC learning framework and prove that every concept class $H$ over a countable domain with Littlestone dimension $d$ and dual VC dimension $v^*$ satisfies \[ \mathrm{LR}(H)\leq 2^{O(d\min\{\log d,v^*\})}. \] This matches the worst-case lower bound of $2^{\Omega(d)}$ up to a logarithmic factor in the exponent and exponentially improves the previous best upper bound $\mathrm{LR}(H)\le 2^{2^{O(d)}}$ of Bun, Livni, and Moran [FOCS 2020]. Unlike earlier bounds of $2^{O_\epsilon(d^2)}$ for fixed accuracy $\epsilon>0$ implied by the work of Ghazi, Golowich, Kumar, and Manurangsi [STOC 2021] and Lyu [STOC 2026], our bound is independent of $\epsilon$.   The $2^{O(d\log d)}$ bound follows from a new inductive framework for bounding list replicability that builds on the recent notion of irreducibility from differentially private learning. translated_title: 基于Littlestone维度的近最优列表可复制性
translated_abstract: 我们在可实现PAC学习框架中研究列表可复制数，并证明可数域上每个Littlestone维度为 d 且对偶VC维度为 v* 的概念类 H 满足 LR(H) ≤ 2^{O(d·min{log d, v*})}。该结果在指数上仅相差一个对数因子的情况下匹配了 2^{Ω(d)} 的最坏情形下界，并指数级地改进了 Bun、Livni 和 Moran [FOCS 2020] 此前的最佳上界 LR(H) ≤ 2^{2^{O(d)}}。与 Ghazi、Golowich、Kumar 和 Manurangsi [STOC 2021] 以及 Lyu [STOC 2026] 的工作所隐含的固定精度 ε>0 下 2^{O_ε(d²)} 的界不同，我们的界与 ε 无关。其中 2^{O(d log d)} 的界来自一个新的界定列表可复制性的归纳框架，该框架建立在差分隐私学习中最近提出的不可约性概念之上；而 2^{O(dv*)} 的界则来自一个简单的全局（此处摘要内容不完整）……
tldr: 本文证明了Littlestone维度为d的概念类的列表可复制数至多为2^{O(d·min{log d, v*})}，该界在指数上仅差一个对数因子即匹配最坏情形下界，并指数级改进了此前最佳结果，从而近乎最优地解决了列表可复制性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the list replicability number of any concept class with Littlestone dimension d is at most 2^{O(d·min{log d, v*})}, matching the worst-case lower bound up to a logarithmic factor in the exponent, exponentially improving the previous best bound, and thereby settling list replicability in a near-optimal manner.
